title: Hysteresis enhancement on a hybrid Dy(III) single molecule magnet/iron oxide nanoparticle system

material_class.structural_family: Dy12 hydroxide/salicylate cluster with cubane-like Dy–O–Dy fragments

synthesis.procedure: Dy(NO3)3·xH2O (0.42 mmol, 0.147 g) and 3,5-di-tert-butylsalicylic acid (0.105 g, 0.42 mmol) were dissolved in 5 mL of MeCN. 1-Dimethylamino-2-propanol (51 μL, 0.42 mmol) and dipropylamine (58 μL, 0.42 mmol) were added, giving a colourless solution. The mixture was treated in a CEM Discover microwave reactor at 140 °C with 250 W for 5 min. The beige pale solution was cooled to room temperature. Crystals were obtained by slow evaporation after 9 days.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Cooled to room temperature; crystals by slow evaporation after 9 days.

properties.summary: Dy12 is an SMM with weak exchange and magnetic anisotropy. χT at 300 K matches 12 uncoupled Dy(III) ions, then decreases on cooling. Magnetization at 2 K does not saturate at 5 T. Only the tail of an out-of-phase AC peak is seen; Debye/Arrhenius analysis gives a small Ueff. No hysteresis down to 2 K; a narrow scan-rate-dependent hysteresis opens below 1 K (micro-SQUID).

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: hybrid oleic-acid-coated iron oxide nanoparticles decorated with Dy12 SMMs

material_class.structural_family: SMM-decorated superparamagnetic iron oxide nanoparticles (oleate spacer)

synthesis.procedure: Parent iron oxide NPs were made from iron oleate (2.78 g, 3 mmol), oleic acid (0.96 mL, 3 mmol) and eicosane (10 mL) in a three-neck flask, heated to 60 °C to melt the solvent, then to 366 °C at 3.3 °C min-1 under stirring, refluxed 10 min, and cooled to 50 °C. NPs were precipitated with acetone/hexane (40 mL/10 mL), centrifuged, and washed three times with acetone/hexane (4:1), giving 10.4 and 13.3 nm NPs. Hybrid NP-Dy12: 20 mg of precipitated NPs were shaken with 2 mg of Dy12 in chloroform for 72 h, then magnetically separated and washed to remove unattached SMMs.
synthesis.temperature: NP synthesis: 60 °C then 366 °C (reflux 10 min), cool to 50 °C; hybridization at unspecified ambient shaking
synthesis.vessel_or_method: three-neck round-bottom flask (NP synthesis); shaking then magnetic separation (hybrid)
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: NP precipitation with acetone/hexane, centrifugation, three washes. Hybrid NPs magnetically separated and washed several times.

properties.summary: Decorating oleic-acid-coated Fe-oxide NPs with Dy12 enhances magnetization hysteresis versus the isolated NP or Dy12 components without changing NP morphology. Enhancement scales with NP surface/volume ratio (stronger for smaller NPs). Dy XMCD shows no remanence, so Dy does not directly add remanence; synergy with the anisotropic Dy12 layer slows NP relaxation. Weak exchange bias is observed.
